statement: Under the frozen definition, s_1(4)=9: every sequence of nine integers, none divisible by 4, contains four distinct positions whose sum is divisible by 4 but not by 16, whereas the length-eight sequence (1,1,1,2,2,2,10,13) contains no such four positions.
contribution: An exact finite resolution candidate for the n=4 case conjectured by Sun. The upper bound is certified by complete enumeration of all 167,960 allowed size-nine residue multiplicity vectors using a bounded-multiplicity generating-function DP, independently agreeing with a structurally different direct checker; the explicit size-eight witness proves sharpness. A bounded same-day primary-literature search found no equivalent exact-case resolution, but does not guarantee priority.
